composition_label: Product comparison (Smart product search) -> Document review (Document automation)

construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, attributes, products, preferences, requirements, documents, evidence; all records have unique IDs except preferences which have unique attribute references
shared_schema.attributes: number with canonical unit (mm/cm/m/g/kg/USD/count), or text; product values are {value, optional unit}; missing attributes permitted
shared_schema.preferences: numeric attribute, positive finite weight, direction min/max
shared_schema.requirements: id, attribute, operator min/max/equals/exists, target winner/all, evidence_required boolean, expected value object except for exists
shared_schema.evidence: id, requirement_id, product_id, document_id, locator, exact quote, asserted value object
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, synthetic, preserved validated input, comparison, review; errors have schema_version, status=error, message
shared_schema.validation: Shared validation rejects unknown fields, duplicate IDs or JSON keys, invalid references, incompatible units, nonfinite numbers, booleans used as numbers and quotes absent from source. Boundary validation recomputes deterministic stage results.

cross_stage_handoffs: compare validates input and emits normalized products, side-by-side values, weighted ranking and winner in a common envelope
review validates the entire comparison envelope before consuming its normalized attributes, winner and ranks
final shared boundary validation checks the complete review against comparison output

behavior.normalization: Numeric units convert within dimension; text casefolds and collapses whitespace
behavior.ranking: Observed min/max utility per numeric preference, weighted average; missing values score zero; constant observed values score one; ties use ascending product ID
behavior.review: Each targeted requirement checks the normalized product value and structured evidence assertions. Checks include actual, expected, rank, source quotes and traceable gap codes
behavior.numeric_comparison: Equality and inclusive requirement boundaries use relative and absolute tolerance 1e-9
behavior.evidence_limit: Exact quote presence and structured assertion agreement only; does not infer whether prose entails the assertion. Conflicting evidence remains a gap even when other evidence matches.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout; success exit 0, validation/file/JSON errors exit 2
